### (4) Deduplication and Filtering

The last stage of the workflow involves two filtering steps to yield the final repertoire. First, the set of unique sequences is identified using the `CollapseSeq.py `tool, allowing for up to 20 interior N-valued positions (`-n 20` and `--inner`), and **you requiring that all reads considered duplicates share the same C-region primer annotation (`--uf CPRIMER`)**. Additionally, the V-segment primer annotations of the set of duplicate reads are propagated into the annotation of each retained unique sequence (`--cf VPRIMER` and `--act set`):

```{bash, eval = F}
docker run -v /Users/emoseley/VHH/data:/data immcantation/suite:4.4.0  \
CollapseSeq.py -s /data/13_VecF1_R2_S13_MPC_primers-pass.fastq -n 20 --inner --uf CPRIMER \
    --cf VPRIMER --act set --outname 13_VecF1_R2_S13
```


```

CollapseSeq.py -s /data/13_VecF1_R2_S13_MPC_primers-pass.fastq -n 20 --inner --uf CPRIMER \
    --cf VPRIMER --act set --outname 13_VecF1_R2_S13
```

## Collapse Seqs

`CollapseSeq` stores the count of duplicate reads for each sequence in the `DUPCOUNT` annotation. Following duplicate removal, the data is subset to only those unique sequence with at least two representative reads by using the group subcommand of `SplitSeq.py` on the count field (`-f DUPCOUNT`) and specifying a numeric threshold (`--num 2`):

```{bash, eval = F}
docker run -v /Users/emoseley/VHH/data:/data immcantation/suite:4.4.0  \
  SplitSeq.py group -s /data/13_VecF1_R2_S13_collapse-unique.fastq -f DUPCOUNT --num 1 --outname 13_VecF1_R2_S13
```

```
docker run -v /Users/emoseley/VHH/data:/data immcantation/suite:4.4.0  \
  SplitSeq.py group -s /data/13_VecF1_R2_S13_collapse-unique.fastq -f DUPCOUNT --num 1 --outname 13_VecF1_R2_S13
```

### (5) Creating an annotation table

Finally, the annotations, including duplicate read count (`DUPCOUNT`), isotype (`CPRIMER`) and V-segment primer (`VPRIMER`), of the final repertoire are then extracted from the `SplitSeq.py` output into a tab-delimited file using the table subcommand of `ParseHeaders.py`:

```{bash, eval = F}
docker run -v /Users/emoseley/VHH/data:/data immcantation/suite:4.4.0  \
  ParseHeaders.py table -s /data/13_VecF1_R2_S13_atleast-1.fastq -f ID DUPCOUNT CPRIMER VPRIMER
```


### Prep for IMGT

```
# Make sure we are where we need to be
cd ~/VHH/data
# Copy over the file
cp 13_VecF1_R2_S13_atleast-1.fastq ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/
# Change the directory
cd ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1
```
## Convert the file to fasta

```{r, echo = T, eval = F}
# Arguments
args <- c("13_VecF1_R2_S13_atleast-1.fastq")
# args = commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)

# Directory
directory <- "/Users/emoseley/VHH/data/"

# Set current working directory to ncbi-igblast-1.17.1
setwd("~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1")

file_origin <- paste("~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/", args[1], sep = '')
file_output <- gsub(".fastq", ".fasta", file_origin)
results <- gsub(".fastq", '.fmt7', args)

# load the fastq
tmp <- ShortRead::readFastq(file_origin)

# write as fasta
ShortRead::writeFasta(tmp, file = file_output)
```

### IMGT

```{bash, eval = F}
bin/igblastn -germline_db_V database/alpaca_vhh_clean/alpaca_V -germline_db_D database/alpaca_vhh_clean/alpaca_D -germline_db_J database/alpaca_vhh_clean/alpaca_J -domain_system imgt -ig_seqtype Ig -organism alpaca -auxiliary_data optional_file/alpaca_gl.aux -outfmt '7 std qseq sseq btop' -query ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/13_VecF1_R2_S13_atleast-1.fasta -out ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/13_VecF1_R2_S13_atleast-1.fmt7
```

```
# Copy back to data
cp 13_VecF1_R2_S13_atleast-1.fmt7 ~/VHH/data
cp 13_VecF1_R2_S13_atleast-1.fasta ~/VHH/data
```

# Prep for IMGT

```
# Move to VHH directory
cd ~/VHH/data
# Copy over the file
cp 14_VecF2_R2_S14_atleast-1.fastq ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/
# Change the directory
cd ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1
```
### Convert the file to fasta

```{r, echo = T, eval = F}
# Arguments
args <- c("14_VecF2_R2_S14_atleast-1.fastq")
# args = commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)

# Directory
directory <- "/Users/emoseley/VHH/data/"

# Set current working directory to ncbi-igblast-1.17.1
setwd("~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1")

file_origin <- paste("~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/", args[1], sep = '')
file_output <- gsub(".fastq", ".fasta", file_origin)
results <- gsub(".fastq", '.fmt7', args)

# load the fastq
tmp <- ShortRead::readFastq(file_origin)

# write as fasta
ShortRead::writeFasta(tmp, file = file_output)
```

### IMGT

```{bash, eval = F}
bin/igblastn -germline_db_V database/alpaca_vhh_clean/alpaca_V -germline_db_D database/alpaca_vhh_clean/alpaca_D -germline_db_J database/alpaca_vhh_clean/alpaca_J -domain_system imgt -ig_seqtype Ig -organism alpaca -auxiliary_data optional_file/alpaca_gl.aux -outfmt '7 std qseq sseq btop' -query ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/14_VecF2_R2_S14_atleast-1.fasta -out ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/14_VecF2_R2_S14.fmt7
```

```
# Copy back to data
cp 14_VecF2_R2_S14.fmt7 ~/VHH/data
cp 14_VecF2_R2_S14_atleast-1.fasta ~/VHH/data
```

### Make Database

```{bash, eval = F}
docker run -v /Users/emoseley/VHH/data:/data immcantation/suite:4.4.0 \
  MakeDb.py igblast -i /data/14_VecF2_R2_S14.fmt7 -s /data/14_VecF2_R2_S14_atleast-1.fasta \
  -r /data/imgt-data/imgt_gapped_alpaca_IGHV.fasta \
  /data/imgt-data/imgt_gapped_alpaca_IGHD.fasta  \
  /data/imgt-data/imgt_gapped_alpaca_IGHJ.fasta \
  --outdir /data/ --failed --format airr --extended
```
